expected_diagnosis: Root filesystem remounted read-only after filesystem error.
recommended_next_checks: Check storage health and take snapshot/backup according to policy.
resolution_guidance: Do not remount rw blindly; escalate controlled repair/offline recovery.
verification: Filesystem healthy after authorized recovery and writes succeed.
production_warning: Không áp dụng lệnh chỉnh sửa trên VPS khách hàng khi chưa có quyền, backup và kế hoạch rollback.
